verdict.line: You lose if you walk into a fully charged Q from brush or let the fight drag into his E/R sustain window; you win by punishing the long stun cast and closing trades fast with your passive shield.

brief.thesis: Camille's measured edge in this lane and in solo kills comes from Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) being a single-target stare with a visible charge-up — it telegraphs itself and can be shut down. The matchup stays even overall because Sion's E (Enrage) lets him trade health for AD mid-fight and his R (Cannibalism) heals him and nearby allies on-hit, so a trade you win at level 4 can be undone if it runs long at level 6+.

theirWindow.when: He fully charges Q unseen from brush
theirWindow.what: A landed Cryptic Gaze stuns you and opens a free follow-up combo. Don't approach a brush he's sitting in without vision, and don't facecheck with low health.

yourWindow.when: He's mid-cast on a charged Q
yourWindow.what: If you have a wall to leap off, use E (Hookshot) to close the gap and knock him up on landing, cutting the cast short before it lands on you.

start.why: The 60.3% win rate pick over Doran's Shield — Camille wins this lane by landing extra autos in short trades, and the lifesteal keeps you healthy through repeated skirmishes.

boots.why: The higher-winrate boots (46.9% over Mercury's Treads' 34.8% pick) — Sion's whole kit is basic-attack damage via Enrage, so flat auto-attack reduction blunts his all-in harder than magic resist does.

core.why: Spikes your trade damage and move speed right as your power window (levels 9-13) opens, letting you force fights before his HP stacking snowballs.
Sustain and cleave to win extended trades against a champion whose own kit is built to out-sustain you through E and R.
The most common third item (40.7% pick within this path) — delays burst damage from his all-in so your passive shield and healing can catch up.

situational.when: you're ahead and need to survive his Enrage all-in without dying to the burst
you're snowballing and want the ability haste to keep E and R available more often
their jungler or mid is stacking magic damage alongside Sion's physical pressure

runes.keystoneWhy: Triggers on your first auto in each trade and scales your own max HP, which matters directly against a Sion who is trying to out-HP you over the course of the lane.

summoners.why: The most-played pair here (51.5% pick) — Ignite seals short trades before his R's lifesteal and ally healing can undo them, and Flash backs up your E engage onto a charging Q.

playing.title: Never walk into unscouted brush
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup: a fully charged Q from brush is the single biggest threat in lane. Ward or flash a brush before you approach it at low HP.

playing.title: Interrupt the charge with E
playing.detail: If you have a wall available, Hookshot onto him while he's mid-cast on Cryptic Gaze — the knockup on landing cuts his channel short and turns his all-in into yours.

playing.title: Trade with W's outer edge
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep's outer half slows and deals extra damage while healing you — stand at max range of the cone rather than melee range for every trade.

playing.title: Punish his E toggle
playing.detail: When Sion turns on Enrage mid-fight he's burning his own health bar for AD. Recognize the commitment and keep trading rather than disengaging.

playing.title: Don't stand near his popped W
playing.detail: Death's Caress's shield explodes in an area around him on expiry or early detonation. Back off once it's up rather than trading through the blast.

playing.title: Disengage after level 6, don't brawl
playing.detail: His R heals him and nearby allies on-hit and grants attack speed — a long melee slugfest favors him once it's online. Hit and reset using your passive shield instead.

playing.title: Force fights in your 9-13 spike
playing.detail: Your Trinity Force/Hydra timing is your best window before his stacked max HP from unit kills makes him hard to burst down late.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reads on Q's charge, E's toggle cost, and R's heal radius are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful when Sion uses a full charged (Q) from inside a brush! Use your passive to hit and run when dealing damage to gain the upper hand! Try to interrupt him mid charge by using your Wall Dive(E).
